name: io.github.jaronskijakub/fatsecret-mcp
description: Unofficial, self-hosted MCP server for logging food to a FatSecret diary through Claude or ChatGPT.

environmentVariables.name: FATSECRET_CONSUMER_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Your FatSecret Platform API consumer key.

environmentVariables.name: FATSECRET_CONSUMER_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Your FatSecret Platform API consumer secret.

environmentVariables.name: FATSECRET_MCP_SIGNING_KEY
environmentVariables.description: A random key of at least 32 characters that signs drafts. Keep it across restarts.

environmentVariables.name: FATSECRET_MCP_USERS
environmentVariables.description: Everyone the server serves, as one JSON line written by `fatsecret-mcp add-user`.

environmentVariables.name: FATSECRET_MCP_USER
environmentVariables.description: With more than one person in FATSECRET_MCP_USERS: the id the server acts as.
